story: Anello was founded in 2018 by Mario Paniccia, who had led Intel's silicon photonics programme, and Mike Horton, a gyro and sensor expert who had earlier started Crossbow. It was incubated in close collaboration with Catapult Ventures. According to Paniccia, the company was founded to close a gap in the industry: fiber-optic gyroscopes are accurate but large and expensive, while MEMS gyros are cheap but drift. The aim was a fiber-optic-class gyro built on a silicon photonic chip for mass-market use.
